decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component system extends the firm's established coating business, so after the investment in a specialized system the firm will keep it even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The injection pump has its own page and a documented field test history going back to 2021, so the firm is heavily and publicly committed to it, and it fits the construction repair segment.
A multi-model pump line built on the firm's proven air motors is a core platform investment that management will sustain.
The fire protection flow monitoring has its own page and supports the announced digitalized, interoperable production direction, so any weak results would be attributed to slow market adoption.
Launched only in 2024 and close to the firm's core offer, the hydraulic two-component system is too new to judge, and early shortfalls would be seen as temporary.
